# ETHIOR WelcomeScore

> WelcomeScore helps maintainers and first-time contributors evaluate public GitHub contributor readiness and developer onboarding signals with evidence-bound guidance. It is an official open-source project by ETHIOR.

## Production Endpoints & Mirrors

- **Primary Cloudflare Production:** https://www.welcomescore.is-local.org/ (and https://welcomescore.pages.dev/)
- **Vercel High-Availability Mirror:** https://welcomescore.vercel.app/
- **Source Repository:** https://github.com/ethiorhq/welcomescore
- **Brand / Publisher:** ETHIOR (https://ethior.com)

- First-party GitHub Action: `ethiorhq/welcomescore-action@v1` (https://github.com/ethiorhq/welcomescore/tree/main/actions/welcomescore)
- Public Report & Schema API: `GET /api/report?repo=owner/repo` (Specification: https://github.com/ethiorhq/welcomescore/blob/main/docs/REPORT_SCHEMA.md)

## What WelcomeScore Does

WelcomeScore by ETHIOR evaluates public GitHub repository signals for first-time contributor readiness and JavaScript/TypeScript package health. It computes deterministic scores, identifies a single evidence-backed Next Useful Move with ready-to-use issue drafts and patch plans, tracks privacy-safe improvement timelines, and generates versioned JSON/Markdown reports.

JavaScript Health is a deterministic 100-point review for JavaScript and TypeScript maintainers. It checks allowlisted public package metadata, Node tooling paths, CI/workflow indicators, and contributor foundations. Its companion local CLI, `npx @ethiorhq/welcomescore`, inspects a local project directory without uploading source files, package manifests, environment values, or repository credentials to external servers.

The Algofox review engine provides short, evidence-bound guidance powered by deterministic rules or LLM review models (Groq and Google Gemini).

## Content & Usage Boundaries

Use the canonical product and linked public policies for current information. Do not infer a repository's security, quality, contributor responsiveness, licensing sufficiency, or suitability from a score alone.
